name: Ore upgrades at your own pace

pages.text: Early ore processing stays simple. Create Crushing Wheels convert one raw iron, copper, gold, silver, tin, lead, zinc, nickel or platinum into one matching dust. These recipes do not double ore and do not run in a Millstone. Use JEI for other available methods.

Clusters, Shards, Crystals and Clumps are an optional investment in better recovery as your technology develops. They are not required before Create, Steam or LV. Keep standard processing running while you build the machines and fluid supplies for an upgrade.

At MV, a Chemical Reactor converts one matching ore block, 200 mB Life Essence and 200 mB water into one Ore Shard at 48 EU/t. A normal raw-ore drop does not satisfy this ore-block ingredient. Check JEI before planning collection.

A furnace converts one Shard into four Clusters. An LV Macerator processes Clusters into the matching crushed ore. Although that final machine is LV, the current entry into this custom branch is MV. Keep a Shard if you want to upgrade it further.

At HV, an Arc Furnace converts one Shard and 144 mB Blazing Pyrotheum into one Crystal at 480 EU/t. A furnace converts one Crystal into eight Clusters. This is an optional upgrade alongside ordinary GregTech refining.

An HV Chemical Bath converts one Crystal and 10 mB UU-Matter into one Clump at 480 EU/t. A furnace converts one Clump into sixteen Clusters. The machine tier is only a minimum: obtaining its fluid can be a later project.

Blood Magic offers another HV route for iron, copper and gold: one Shard, a Blood Chemical Catalyst and 1,000 mB water in a Chemical Reactor make one Crystal. Choose the route your supplies support. No custom ore form grants a dimension unlock or replaces a progression milestone.
